kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said
mine: who through the mouth of our father David, your servant, said by the Holy Spirit
note: The early text (P74, Sinaiticus, A, B) has a famously awkward phrase naming the Holy Spirit and "our father"; the TR smooths it.
pais as at 3:13; "child" (1611 sense "boy, servant") is now misleading. Also 4:30.
